scheda_en.intro:
Hydrogen phosphate or monohydrogen phosphate (systematic name) is the inorganic ion with the formula [HPO4]2-. Its formula can also be written as [PO3(OH)]2-. Together with dihydrogen phosphate, hydrogen phosphate occurs widely in natural systems. Their salts are used in fertilizers and in cooking.  Most hydrogenphosphate salts are colorless, water soluble, and nontoxic.
It is a conjugate acid of phosphate [PO4]3- and a conjugate base of dihydrogen phosphate [H2PO4]−.
It is formed when a pyrophosphate anion [P2O7]4− reacts with water H2O by hydrolysis, which can give hydrogenphosphate:

[P2O7]4− + H2O ⇌ 2 [HPO4]2−
